name: zc_avatar_df_off

tests.name: there is a Project Avatar to spawn repeatedly
every arrival was measured with the clock running
the answer is recorded: first-time cost, or every-time cost

detail.note: the SAME figure spawned eight times. A large gap between the first and the rest means the cost belongs to the figure and pre-warming at load removes it from play entirely. A flat series means it belongs to the act of spawning, pre-warming buys nothing, and the build has to be spread across frames instead.
